d:
In America’s far North, tidelands are gripped by snow and ice for over half the year. When spring arrives with its brief window of fair weather, nature provides in abundance…but the opportunity is fleeting. Brown bears, great blue herons, bald eagles, and dragonflies go on the offensive to seize what they can.
